issues.claim: Период охлаждения защищает от постоянных колебаний числа реплик. / A cooldown period prevents the replica count from flapping.
issues.problem: The cited Container Apps page says the cool down period only takes effect when scaling in from the final replica to 0 and does not affect removal of any other replicas. KEDA behaves the same way. Presenting it as general flapping protection teaches a wrong fact. Flapping between N and N-1 replicas is controlled by the HPA scale-down stabilization window in KEDA/AKS, which is not a Container Apps setting.
issues.suggestedFix: RU: 'Период охлаждения (cooldown) в KEDA и Container Apps действует только при переходе с последней реплики в ноль; от колебаний между N и N-1 репликами защищает окно стабилизации HPA (scaleDown stabilizationWindow), а в Container Apps масштабирование вниз определяет платформа.' EN: 'The cooldown period in KEDA and Container Apps applies only when scaling from the last replica to zero; flapping between N and N-1 replicas is damped by the HPA scale-down stabilization window, while Container Apps manages scale-in itself.'
